## Historical audit: S0231

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_1/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_80372956/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below identify JSONL lines and the supplied character ranges; all observations are complete, not split.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The student was asked to reconstruct one indoor RGB photograph as separate 3D meshes, matching camera and framing, then inspect a render. The image itself is not visible in this audit. A ceiling and chandelier are the student's interpretation, not independently established scene facts. [line 1, chars 0–5604) |
| Actual scene program | The student produced a nonempty program defining multiple objects: roof panels and seams, rafters, timber framing, fixing marks, and a radial chandelier with globe, suspension, arms and cups. Components are grouped into assets and positioned to suggest connections; geometric contact and correct pose are not verified. [student model_response, line 3, chars 0–7994) |
| Materials and view | The program assigns colors and metallic/roughness values; board joints are modeled as geometry, but no procedural image texture is evident despite a texture comment. It specifies an upward-facing camera, three area lights, world illumination and Cycles rendering. These are settings, not evidence that framing, lighting or materials match the photograph. [line 3, chars 0–7994) |
| Execution and validation | The runner attempted the program once. Blender timed out after approximately 516 seconds; the result was `ok: false`, with empty stdout/stderr and `image: null`. No successful render, visual review, correction, or submitted successful build is shown. The cause of the timeout and whether geometry was partly built are unknown. [execute, line 4, chars 0–8625); execution_result, line 5, chars 0–1063) |
| Exploration and teaching | One student response and one execution are visible. The initial session reports zero tool calls; no autonomous iterative exploration is evidenced. No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution of such an update, or adoption is present in this student trace. [codex_session, line 2, chars 0–2840); lines 3–5] |

**Outcome:** Technical interruption; reconstruction correctness and formal success are unknown, not independently verified partial correctness or an established algorithm failure. The code is not an empty patch. The recorded timeout does not establish whether scene complexity, rendering settings, or another cause was responsible.

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Transferably, a generated scene specification is distinct from a successful build and a visually validated match; render-budget failures can prevent the intended feedback loop. Task-specific hypotheses—including whether the ceiling geometry, chandelier connections, pose, framing, lighting, or material appearance match the reference—remain unresolved without the unavailable images and a successful render.
